Source: https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/romulus-clickfix-platform-tricks-users.html
Technical source linked by the article: https://www.forescout.com/blog/romulus-analysis-of-a-new-multi-payload-clickfix-delivery-platform/

Concrete evidence: the linked report specifies negative-integer arrays,
sample-specific additive character reconstruction, ScriptBlock.Create,
self-path storage, decimal-IP MSI download and silent installation, and
hidden passworded 7zr extraction. The article's ROMULUS routing diagram
also specifies the six IPs, /s and /app routes, and archive host.
The article contains no code blocks. Its second embedded image describes
an unrelated JWT/FabricShell chain; no detections were derived from it.

The feed samples are synthetic reconstructions, never executed. Additive
keys, local variable names and extraction-directory selection are chosen
for reconstruction; they are not claimed as original malware bytes.
The report specifies GitHub-hosted legitimate 7zr.exe but no exact asset
URL/version: the URL in the archive reconstruction is illustrative.
Dot-sourcing, Invoke/InvokeReturnAsIs, and JS/Python/C# pwsh hosts are
future variants of the documented technique, not newly observed campaign
artifacts. PowerShell Core's reconstruction/evaluation works on Unix as
well as Windows; the MSI and Win32 archive payload routes target Windows.
Every one of the six feed samples passed its first atomscan scan with two
suspicious traits. Obfuscation plus invocation warrants suspicious, not
hostile: no unseen payload behavior is inferred from opaque integers.

Detection corrections:
- Generalize negative-array/offset/evaluation observations to embedded
  source hosts and Unix PowerShell; keep names and keys unconstrained.
- Add direct ScriptBlock method invocation and the dot call operator.
  Objective descriptions retain co-occurrence language, not data-flow proof.
- Expand the canonical notable decimal URL observation to pathless hosts,
  queries, fragments and optional ports. Retire the inert objective matcher
  that accidentally used regex text as a substring: decimal addressing
  alone is neutral, as the existing benign MSI fixtures establish.
- Relocate the incomplete $env: fragment out of HTTP download capability
  into source syntax, so it cannot satisfy response-acquisition directory
  consumers without an HTTP operation. Preserve its explicit cradle use.
- The source-syntax leaf was at its 100-rule budget. Audit found two
  function-name-only observations in that leaf: telemetry handler/emitter
  definitions belong in source/naming. Move them without matcher, scope,
  severity or confidence changes; update the two exact source-profile
  consumers. No whole-leaf syntax/naming selectors reference these leaves;
  common ancestor membership stays the same. The revised syntax leaf has
  99 rules and the naming leaf stays below its existing budget.

Benign controls and positive regression fixtures are registered in
expectations.toml. The per-file validator supports benign and hostile tables,
not a suspicious table. As with the existing negative-offset fixture, these
obfuscation samples use the legacy hostile corpus with min_hostile=0,
min_suspicious=2, and exact required behavior IDs. Numeric-IP-only admin code, character data without eval,
and plain ScriptBlock invocation must remain free of suspicious findings.

Indicators: the feed ENDPOINTS includes all six article IPs, plus the linked
report's archive/C2 hosts and both decimal aliases. novatrafficcore.lol is
explicitly unconfirmed as a ROMULUS link. SHA256 contains all 15 published
component/stage/archive hashes, including the legitimate sideload host as
retrieval context. No MD5/SHA-1 or malicious package coordinates/versions
were supplied; PURLS is empty. No hashes of synthetic samples are included.

Cleave facts were captured for the source wrappers and independently
reconstructed decoded stages. The integer-offset layer is not automatically
decoded in the current engine, so no detection is attributed to its hidden
MSI/archive strings. The reconstruction script verifies exact character
round trips; decoded source facts are separate evidence, not extra samples.
